fixwave3-verify.name: fixwave3-verify
fixwave3-verify.prompt:
Adversarially verify fixes committed since the previous review rounds. Work ONLY in a temp clone outside the checkout (for example: git clone --local --no-hardlinks . $env:TEMP/fixwave3-copy, then git -C $env:TEMP/fixwave3-copy checkout --detach 987ffaf9); never edit the checkout; write only your assigned report file.

Context: Azure Blob backup/restore for the VLite server (src/server/cloud_backup.rs, backup_policy.rs, cloud_recovery.rs, recovery_bundle.rs, credentials.rs, users.rs, src/server.rs). Scope PRD: docs/projects/feature-backup-ha/feature-backup-ha.prd.md (backup-only milestone; HA, fencing, replicated standby and dashboard administration are OUT of scope).

Commits to verify (git show each; locate code by symbol, line numbers drift): 775c35b8 AZ-STALE; 6daa1d65 M5 shutdown fence + SO-M4; 5d9230b0 W-01 OpenAPI parity allowlist; 5b824281 A3 dead_code allows; 0870af12 N-01 no-replace rename in restore_pinned; 6ba5af10 N-03 forced unpin vs pin registration race; 1292ea86 N-04 failed policy reread must not leave the old policy usable; 532ef15b N-02 remove_stale_staging safety; 987ffaf9 N-05 recovery import cleanup after every step.

For each commit: (1) say whether the original defect is closed, with evidence (code path plus the test that fails without the fix); (2) mutation replay on M5 and N-01..N-05: in the temp clone weaken or revert ONE condition at a time, run the focused tests, record KILLED or SURVIVED, and for survivors propose a persistent test; (3) hunt NEW defects introduced by the fixes: TOCTOU, error text leaking the output path or a secret, cleanup deleting more than intended, deadlocks, panics, Windows/Linux/macOS differences in rename_no_replace.

Run on Windows in the temp clone: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; focused lib tests for server::cloud_recovery, server::cloud_backup, server::backup_policy and server::recovery_bundle (cargo test --locked --features server --lib with each module path as the filter); cargo test --locked --workspace --all-features --test graph_surface_parity; python tests/api_reference.py; python tests/api_route_inventory.py; python tests/admin_route_coverage.py (set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1). Do not run ignored Azurite tests, real Azure or anything needing credentials.

Already known, do NOT re-report: legacy manifest format (documentation only), RecoveryCredential dropping rate/vector limits, PolicyCapture range validation, serde text echoed in manifest errors, the .tmp name exception in bundle directory checks, missing unique capture id, surviving mutants in certify/secret-reference/live capture, missing free-space injection seam, the compaction flake (separate task), legal-hold test gap, no Windows directory fsync, free-space probe returning None on Windows.

Forbidden: commits, pushes, PRs, deployment, secrets, deploy/ files, any edit to the checkout besides your report. Format: Markdown with sections Verified closed / Still open / New; each finding has ID, severity, symbol and file:line, evidence, suggested fix. State exactly what you did not run.

w02-flake-diagnosis.name: w02-flake-diagnosis
w02-flake-diagnosis.prompt:
Attribute a flaky test. Test: tests/server_compaction.rs, function selection_effect_error_fences_until_restart_finishes_the_selection. It failed once in a full-workspace run on a Windows host at a commit that added backup code; the test file is unchanged. Goal: decide whether the flake pre-dates the backup work and find its cause. Never weaken the assertion. Do all work in temp clones OUTSIDE the checkout (for example: git clone --local --no-hardlinks . $env:TEMP/flake-a); write only your assigned report file in the checkout.

Steps:
1. Make clone A at commit c61aae91 (before the backup work) and clone B at 987ffaf9 (the pinned base; git checkout --detach in each). Use one shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the checkout (for example $env:TEMP/flake-target) to reuse dependency builds.
2. Build each with: cargo test --locked --features server,compaction-test-hooks --test server_compaction --no-run, then run the produced test binary directly with the test name as the filter 40 times sequentially on an idle machine. Record pass/fail counts and, for each failure, the full assertion message and panic location.
3. Repeat 40 runs per clone under CPU load (one busy-loop process per logical core, started before the runs and stopped after). Do not run copies of the test concurrently unless you first check for fixed ports or shared temp paths, and say if failures are collisions caused by that.
4. Run the whole server_compaction binary 10 times per clone to see whether neighbouring tests interact.
5. Read the test and the code it exercises (selection effect error, fence, restart) and propose a root cause: timing assumption, shared static state, port or temp-dir collision, test-hook serialization, and so on. Support it with an experiment in your temp clone (for example a sleep or barrier) and show how the failure rate changes.

Report: failure rates per configuration with counts, the exact failure text, the cause with file:line, whether it is pre-existing (reproduces at c61aae91) or backup-induced, and a proposed test-side or code-side fix (describe it; do not apply it to the checkout). If it never reproduces in 160 runs, say so plainly with the numbers and list the likeliest suspects.

Forbidden: commits, pushes, PRs, deployment, secrets, deploy/ files, any edit to the checkout besides your report. Format: Markdown. State exactly what you did not run.
